lines.text: LinkedIn built its own deployment engine, and deployment failures dropped sharply.
Argo CD makes a Kubernetes cluster match what is saved in Git. LinkedIn used one per cluster.
lines.title: The old setup

lines.text: At LinkedIn's size, one app's activity slowed syncs for all. Over eighty thousand pods took more than ten minutes.
lines.title: Trouble at scale

lines.text: The new engine gives each deployment its own short-lived pod, with no shared state.
lines.title: The new engine

lines.text: It replaces whole objects instead of patching them, and flags drift when the live system differs.
lines.title: Safer updates

lines.text: It now covers over 250 clusters, and failed deployments are caught in two and a half minutes, not sixteen.
lines.title: Results

lines.text: LinkedIn says the engine is not the only reason, but isolating each deployment helped it scale.
lines.title: Takeaways

points.text: Small tools can break at scale
